description: This file defines the AboutAnySoftKeyboardFragment class, which is an Android Fragment responsible for displaying about information, handling user interactions such as opening URLs, sharing app details, and navigating to licenses. It also contains an inner class for displaying additional software licenses.

classes.name: AboutAnySoftKeyboardFragment
classes.description: Main fragment class for displaying about information and handling user interactions related to app info, privacy, website, sharing, and rating.

classes.name: AdditionalSoftwareLicensesFragment
classes.description: Inner class fragment for displaying additional software licenses.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment's view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI elements, sets texts, and attaches click listeners.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events for various UI elements, performing navigation, opening URLs, or sharing content.

methods.name: shareAppDetails
methods.description: Creates and launches an intent to share app details via other apps.
